task_criteria: The filing commit adds exactly one board row (CF-082) whose probe reproduces the truncation, and the tree gate is green. Verify: 1) git show --stat HEAD names .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl and .coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl only; 2) the COMMITTED board tree (git show HEAD:.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl | jq) carries CF-082 with status pending and a non-empty probe; 3) run that probe string from the row at HEAD and confirm it prints floor_gib 5 and an admission PASS; 4) bash tests/selftest.sh prints SELFTEST: PASS and scripts/boardctl validate prints RESULT: OK; 5) git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD is 0. This is a FILING task: do NOT evaluate or require the underlying disk-floor FIX - CF-082 is a pending row and the repair is future work.
